decisions.reason: Keyboard-first command palette duplicates the native palette already in lib/client.js (opens on Cmd+K/Ctrl+K with focused input). No distinct outcome.

Sidebar app drawer + dockable split workspace + project control room is a host UI surface, not a repeatable task outcome. Usable only as a user-installed host plugin; nothing here becomes a canonical capability.
prerequisites: user installs the host plugin in DSH's own plugin flow

decisions.reason: Image Q&A, pasted-image recognition, and screenshot-to-UI description is a repeatable inspect-data outcome with clear inputs (images), outputs (descriptions/answers), and refusal cases (no image, unreadable image). Propose a bounded vision-inspection pack.
prerequisites: image-capable model lane with digit-read confirmation

decisions.reason: Agent-team orchestration is already a native session capability; wrapping it in a workflow adds no distinct user outcome. Use the native feature.
Offensive-security tooling (penetration testing, red-team assessments) with no authorized-testing task binding or scope contract in this program. Cannot become a selectable capability as-is.
decisions.revisit: an authorized-testing task binding with a reviewed scope contract and refusal cases

decisions.reason: Context dashboard/browser/sidebar is a context-visibility surface. The readiness model already separates present/installed/verified facts; a context-visibility strip could ride a future C-surface, but no contract, binding, or negative evals exist yet. Proposal only.

Spreadsheets, docs, slides, and tables through a real office surface is a repeatable document outcome (inputs: structured data + template; outputs: .xlsx/.docx/.pptx artifacts; evidence: file bytes + formula checks). Propose a bounded office-artifact pack reusing native office tooling where it suffices.
prerequisites: artifact output checks independent of the producer
